description: This file implements a Koala noise suppression audio filter for the Pipecat project, utilizing PicoVoice's Koala engine to reduce background noise in audio streams. It defines a KoalaFilter class that manages audio buffering, engine initialization, and real-time filtering, along with control frame handling.

classes.name: KoalaFilter
classes.description: An audio filter that uses PicoVoice's Koala engine to perform real-time noise suppression on audio streams. Handles initialization, stream filtering, buffering, and control commands.

methods.name: None __init__(self, *, access_key: str)
methods.description: Initializes the KoalaFilter with an access key for PicoVoice's Koala engine and sets up internal state.

methods.name: start(self, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Configures the filter with the input audio sample rate and checks if it matches the Koala engine's required sample rate.

methods.name: stop(self)
methods.description: Resets and cleans up the Koala engine when stopping the filter.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: FilterControlFrame)
methods.description: Handles control frames to enable or disable the filtering.

methods.name: bytes filter(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Applies noise suppression to input audio bytes, buffering data as necessary to process in chunks suitable for the Koala engine.

ctags.name: filter
ctags.pattern: /^    async def filter(self, audio: bytes) -> bytes:$/
